name: url-allowlist
description: Restricts WebFetch to the domains you allow.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: allow: only the listed hosts may be fetched. block: every host except the blocked ones may be.

hosts.title: Allowed hosts
hosts.description: Comma-separated. A host also allows its subdomains (github.com allows api.github.com); *.example.com allows subdomains only. Used in allow mode.

blockedHosts.title: Blocked hosts
blockedHosts.description: Comma-separated, with the same matching rules. Used in block mode.

checkBash.title: Also check curl and wget
checkBash.description: Apply the same rules to http(s):// URLs in Bash commands that run curl, wget or httpie.
